description: This Scala source file defines utility functions for parsing and extracting version information from Spark version strings, including major, minor, and patch versions.

classes.name: VersionUtils
classes.description: Object containing utility methods for handling Spark version strings, such as extracting major, minor, and patch versions.

methods.name: majorVersion
methods.description: Returns the major version number from a Spark version string.

methods.name: minorVersion
methods.description: Returns the minor version number from a Spark version string.

methods.name: shortVersion
methods.description: Returns the short version string (major.minor.patch) from a Spark version string.

methods.name: majorMinorVersion
methods.description: Returns a tuple of (major, minor) version numbers from a Spark version string.

methods.name: majorMinorPatchVersion
methods.description: Returns an Option containing a tuple of (major, minor, patch) version numbers if the input is valid.
